message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal long‑weekend holidays** that Canadians celebrated in 2023.  
(If you’re building an app, you’ll want to double‑check the provincial calendars—some provinces observe different holidays or shift the observance day.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if shifted) | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | Federal holiday; observed on the next working day. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK) | Monday Feb 20 | – | Only in those provinces. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | Religious holiday; always a long weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday; long weekend. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | Federal holiday; observed on the following Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | Long weekend. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | Long weekend. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | Observed on the following Monday. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | Long weekend. |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | Not a long weekend. |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a simple array or database table.  
   ```json
   [
     {"name":"New Year’s Day","date":"2023-01-01","observed":"2023-01-02"},
     {"name":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20"},
     {"name":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07"},
     {"name":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22"},
     {"name":"Canada Day","date":"2023-07-01","observed":"2023-07-03"},
     {"name":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04"},
     {"name":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09"},
     {"name":"Remembrance Day","date":"2023-11-11","observed":"2023-11-13"},
     {"name":"Christmas Day","date":"2023-12-25"}
   ]
   ```

2. **Filter by province** if you need to show only the holidays that apply to a particular region.

3. **Highlight long weekends** by checking if the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on those days).

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same list for another year or for a specific province!
